datasets.name: 2019 Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.source: Prof. Shunping Ji’s group at Wuhan University
datasets.verbatim: the positive samples also included the 2019 Bijie landslide dataset produced by Prof. Shunping Ji’s group at Wuhan University (http://gpcv.whu.edu.cn/data/, accessed on 3 May 2023) [33].

datasets.name: Remote sensing images from Google Earth Engine
datasets.verbatim: The remote sensing images used in this study were obtained from the Google Earth Engine platform

methods.name: SE-YOLOv7
methods.summary: An improved YOLOv7 model that incorporates the Squeeze-and-Excitation (SE) attention mechanism into the backbone and replaces the original loss function with the VariFocal loss function to enhance landslide detection accuracy in complex backgrounds.
methods.source: Qing Liu, Tingting Wu, Yahong Deng, and Zhiheng Liu
methods.verbatim: This study innovates based on the YOLOv7 algorithm model and proposes a new SE-YOLOv7 model by adding the SE squeezed attention mechanism and VariFocal loss function

availability.author_statement: The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author, upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced and linked, and the remote sensing imagery is accessible via Google Earth Engine. However, the custom SE-YOLOv7 code is not provided or linked.
